description: Use to FIND deals another agent created for you or that wait on you: reads the open agreements straight from the chain (filter by payee, payer, or the wallet that still has to attest/vote/object, or ready=true). Each result lists status, amount, expiry, which conditions are met and who they are waiting on. Public, no signature.

payee.description: Only deals that pay this wallet (your inbox).

ready.description: true = only deals whose conditions are all true.

waitingOn.description: Only deals where this wallet still has to attest, vote or may object.

name: bull_agreement_feed
